text:
Absolutely fantastic first time pass this morning for Maya at Nelson Driving Test Centre with only 3️⃣ driver faults 😀

What a massive rollercoaster of emotions on the build up to it! There were tears, laughter and self doubt all mixed in with plenty of, "I can do this! I've got this"! 

All you had to do Maya is stay positive and have self belief! I knew you was ready for your test and you just had to go and prove it! And you did! 😀

A brilliant result and it's great to see all your hard work paying off! 

Keep driving safe! 😀🎉🚗🚦
